scope: Dependency and quality compatibility gate only; no session projection, automatic publication, recall injection, or tool execution is enabled by E0.

truthOwners.kind: type-specific required evidence roles and publication validation
truthOwners.exactIdentity: type-specific deterministic kernel identity inside the canonical transaction
truthOwners.recall: hard eligibility and exact signals, followed by lexical/dense ranking and abstain

requiredNegatives: unresolved, brainstorm-only, model-claim-only and one-off sessions

lexical.decision: selected as the always-available rebuildable lexical projection

denseRuntime.packaging: optional runtime dependency; model artifacts are never inside the npm tarball
denseRuntime.decision: selected for an opt-in local worker with a typed lexical fallback

denseModel.decision: recommended local dense model for bilingual recall only; not authorized for extraction, kind classification, exact merging, publication, injection, or execution

rejectedOrGated.Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5: failed the frozen bilingual dense-recall top-1 gate
rejectedOrGated.fts5: available in the tested macOS arm64 Node 22.23.1 and 24.21.0 builds, but not selected because cross-platform packed compatibility and a measured scale need are not established
rejectedOrGated.sqliteVecAnn: not admitted because exact scan has not violated the latency or memory gate
rejectedOrGated.reranker: not admitted because no measured hard-negative benefit exists
rejectedOrGated.graphDatabase: not admitted because no real multi-hop or temporal bottleneck exists
rejectedOrGated.memoryFramework: not admitted because it would duplicate the existing Candidate, Version, Evidence, approval, and lifecycle owners

nativeBuildPolicy.onnxruntime-node: 1.24.3 postinstall is explicitly allowed and was executed
nativeBuildPolicy.sharp: 0.34.5 install script remains disabled because text embedding does not consume it
nativeBuildPolicy.protobufjs: 7.6.6 postinstall remains disabled because the selected path does not require it
nativeBuildPolicy.lockfileIntegrity: pnpm lockfile integrity fields and the repository supply-chain policy are authoritative for npm artifacts

runtimeDependencyInventory.copyleftBoundary: One LGPL-3.0-or-later libvips platform binary is a transitive package of unused sharp inside the optional Transformers.js runtime; it is dynamically installed and is not bundled into the plugin tarball.

benchmarks.interpretation: The embedding result is only a small frozen compatibility and hard-negative gate. It is not a statistical product-benefit claim. MiniSearch and the current B0 score well on this set only after exact task-family, exposure and error-code fields are supplied; both fail the extraction and exact-identity gates.

packedArtifact.note: The temporary tarball is reproducible from the committed source and is not retained as a second release artifact at this dependency-only gate.

output: normalized finite Float32 vectors in input order
invariants: no remote call without a durable opt-in and current settings revision
no credential or input text in receipt or logs
a provider failure leaves lexical retrieval available
vectors from different generation identities are never compared
semantic similarity never grants save, merge, injection, approval, or execution authority

implementations.transformers_js: selected real E3 implementation; loads the verified local revision directory and never needs remote metadata at runtime
implementations.ollama: contract frozen for POST /api/embed batch input and normalized vectors; adapter remains unimplemented until a user-configured consumer exists
implementations.openai_compatible: contract only; requires explicit remote opt-in, endpoint allowlist and DSH-owned credential reference before implementation

projectionManifest.canonicalSource: active Experience Version plus canonical TaskFingerprint; projection is rebuildable and never a writer of Experience truth
projectionManifest.denseText: versioned deterministic projection of the same fields; query and passage prefixes are part of the generation identity
projectionManifest.storage: the single disposable Experience projection sidecar selected for E1; lexical and dense generations switch atomically only after complete rebuild
projectionManifest.fallback: missing, corrupt, stale or unsupported dense generation is ignored and the same hard filters plus lexical path remain active
forbidden: using projection generation as suggestion group identity
treating projection data as canonical publication or Evidence
placing model artifacts in the npm tarball

identityDecision.groupScope: kind + local owner/workspace scope + canonical task family
identityDecision.procedureKernel: ordered normalized successful actions + hard prerequisites + independent verifier identity
identityDecision.diagnosticKernel: symptom/error signature + confirmed cause or discriminating check + repair + recovery verifier identity
identityDecision.exact: all group-scope and type-specific kernel fields match after deterministic normalization
identityDecision.possibleDuplicate: semantic similarity can only create a review candidate

saveExperienceSuggestionTransaction.preTransaction: read an immutable sidecar snapshot and capture suggestion revision, reviewDigest, sourceDigest and occurrenceIdentity
saveExperienceSuggestionTransaction.transactionMode: BEGIN IMMEDIATE through the existing ExperienceDatabase.write owner
orderedChecks: resolve owner actor and verify command idempotency payload digest
verify immutable snapshot revision, reviewDigest, sourceDigest, retention, sensitive-content policy and save readiness
reject possible_duplicate and any non-ready state
recompute type-specific exact identity from canonical active Versions
if exact exists, insert one occurrence-derived EvidenceStatement and EvidenceAssessment against the current Version
if exact does not exist, reuse publication validation and create exactly one Series, Version, components, Evidence, assessment and governance decision
persist one DomainReceipt, audit event, command deduplication row and projection outbox event
assert store invariants and commit before changing sidecar disposition
saveExperienceSuggestionTransaction.idempotency: same commandId and payload returns the same receipt; same occurrence/source identity uses deterministic Evidence identity so a new command cannot duplicate Evidence
saveExperienceSuggestionTransaction.concurrency: every connection performs the active-Version exact-identity scan after BEGIN IMMEDIATE; PublishCandidate reuses the same final guard
saveExperienceSuggestionTransaction.possibleDuplicate: returns a typed review conflict and never auto-merges
saveExperienceSuggestionTransaction.crashBoundary: canonical commit wins; sidecar saved disposition is repaired from receipt/source identity and never rolls back or repeats canonical facts

mapping.occurrenceAndSourceIdentity: Evidence source refs + audit source refs + receipt payload
mapping.newSeriesResult: existing experience_series, experience_versions, components, evidence, assessment and governance tables
mapping.existingSeriesResult: new evidence_statements and evidence_assessments bound to the current Version

canonicalSchemaReuse.stopCondition: If E3 cannot preserve one receipt, exact concurrency safety or occurrence idempotency with these containers, stop and revise the active plan instead of silently adding another canonical writer.

retentionDecision.basis: bounded product default requested for unattended suggestions and sufficient for the first recent-session vertical; both are user-configurable and E1 verifies recent-N plus TTL garbage collection
retentionDecision.nonClaim: No long-term usage-density optimum is claimed before post-release telemetry exists.

rollback.disableDense: set embedding provider to disabled and rebuild lexical generation; canonical Experiences remain unchanged
rollback.missingOptionalDependency: report provider_unavailable and use lexical retrieval
rollback.modelChange: build a new isolated generation and switch only after manifest verification; never compare old and new vectors
rollback.packageUninstall: model cache and suggestion sidecar are disposable; canonical schema remains v8
